description: Greenhouse connector (read-only). Surfaces the company's Greenhouse Harvest job openings as `greenhouse:job` items in the local index — the job name, the department + office names/locations, the workflow status, the requisition id, the confidential flag, and the open/close/created/updated timestamps. Useful for answering recruiting questions ("which engineering jobs are open?", "find the job for the staff SRE requisition") without leaving Nimbus. HTTP Basic auth where the Harvest API key is the username and the password is empty (`Authorization: Basic base64(<api_key>:)` — the trailing colon is the empty password; never logged). The SaaS host (harvest.greenhouse.io) is fixed. Greenhouse paginates `/v1/jobs` with `?per_page=100&page=N` returning a bare JSON array `[ ...jobs... ]` (NOT an envelope) — increment `page` while the array is a full page of 100, stop on a short/empty page. `created_at` / `updated_at` are ISO-8601 strings parsed to epoch MILLISECONDS. The canonical URL is null (the Harvest API exposes no per-job public URL without a board token). Candidates / applications are deliberately deferred (candidate PII; out of scope for v1) — v1 indexes job openings only.
author: Nimbus
